name: shillibeer-london-omnibus
description: A coachbuilder ran a horse-drawn omnibus carrying many passengers between Paddington and the Bank in London.

name: new-york-harlem-horsecar
description: Horse-drawn cars on iron rails carried New Yorkers along the Bowery, the world's first street railway.

name: san-francisco-clay-street-cable-car
description: A cable-hauled car made its first run down a steep hill, launching the city's famous cable car system.

name: richmond-electric-streetcar-network
description: A Virginia city opened the first large-scale electric streetcar network, proving trolleys could climb hills and carry crowds.

name: city-south-london-deep-tube
description: Electric locomotives hauled passengers through deep, circular tunnels beneath London, ending smoky underground travel.

name: budapest-metro-opens
description: The first underground railway on the European mainland opened under a grand avenue as part of a national celebration.

name: paris-metro-opens
description: The first line of the Paris Metro began carrying passengers beneath the capital as visitors flocked to a world fair.

name: new-york-subway-opens
description: Crowds rode the city's first underground line from City Hall to Harlem on a gala evening, launching the subway.

name: buenos-aires-subte-opens
description: The first underground line in Latin America and the Southern Hemisphere began running beneath the Argentine capital.

name: madrid-metro-opens
description: The king inaugurated a short underground line in Madrid, the start of one of Europe's largest metro networks.

name: tokyo-ginza-line-opens
description: Asia's first subway opened in Tokyo with a short stretch of track between Ueno and Asakusa.

name: moscow-metro-opens
description: The Soviet capital opened its first underground line, with marble halls and chandeliers intended as palaces for the people.

name: toronto-yonge-subway-opens
description: Canada's first subway line opened beneath Yonge Street, carrying commuters through downtown Toronto.

name: rome-metro-opens
description: Rome opened its first metro line, built slowly because ancient ruins lay beneath the streets.

name: montreal-metro-opens
description: Montreal opened a rubber-tyred metro with art-filled stations, ahead of a world exposition.

name: mexico-city-metro-opens
description: Mexico City began running trains on its first line, with pictogram station icons so riders who could not read could navigate.

name: curitiba-bus-rapid-transit
description: A Brazilian city launched dedicated bus lanes with raised tube stations, a model copied by cities worldwide.

name: washington-metro-opens
description: The American capital opened the first stretch of its vaulted-ceiling metro system.

name: hong-kong-mtr-opens
description: Hong Kong began running trains on its first Mass Transit Railway line beneath Kowloon.

name: vancouver-skytrain-opens
description: A driverless, automated light metro began running through Vancouver, opened in time for a world fair.

name: singapore-mrt-opens
description: Singapore's first Mass Rapid Transit trains carried passengers on a short stretch of a new island-wide network.

name: shanghai-metro-opens
description: Shanghai opened its first subway line, the start of what became the longest metro network in the world.

name: bogota-transmilenio-opens
description: Bogota launched a high-capacity bus rapid transit system with express lanes, inspired by the Curitiba model.

name: dubai-metro-opens
description: Dubai opened a driverless metro, then the longest automated rail network in the world, running through the desert city.

name: sydney-metro-opens
description: Sydney began operating its first fully automated, driverless metro line in the north-west of the city.
